name: Adamantine Battleaxe
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 150, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 471
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 150, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 471
Aura no aura (nonmagical) CL
Slot none; Price 3,010 gp; Weight 6 lbs.
Description
This nonmagical axe is made of adamantine. As a masterwork weapon, it has a +1 enhancement bonus on attack rolls.
